snippet.title: 『Aporia Aegis Antechamber』ver2.0 PV
snippet.description:
NEW VERSION 2.0! Play on Itch.io! https://duskworks.itch.io/aporia-aegis-antechamber

Aporia Aegis Antechamber is a High Fantasy, Lite-RPG Dungeon Crawler set in the fictional world of Viridia, populated by raccoon-like humanoid sentients named Lanir, and many other creatures. Control a prince and his maid as they brave the yet inviolate labyrinth of Nan.

Game created in RPG Maker MV originally for the Toasty Jam, post-jam build fixing several bugs and enemy balancing now available!
